channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Judge to question DOJ on Epstein file redactions and withheld Trump materials
item.description: A federal judge scheduled a hearing in a lawsuit by an independent journalist alleging improper redactions and withheld documents.

item.title: Three inmates scheduled for execution in Tennessee, Alabama, and Oklahoma on same day
item.description: Three inmates in Tennessee, Alabama, and Oklahoma are set for execution Thursday. If all proceed, it would be the first such occurrence in nearly 16 years.

item.title: Iran says Strait of Hormuz under its control after Trump threat
item.description: Tehran stated that the Strait of Hormuz is under its control, responding to President Trump's comment that the U.S. might keep it.

item.title: Meta dismisses allegations in latest social media addiction trial as unsubstantiated
item.description: Jury selection began Wednesday in a new trial over claims that Meta designed its apps to be addictive for young users.
